_comment: Which public export of @quinscape/qlive-ts is looked up on which generated page,
and in which order it appears there. Read by tooling/generateApiDocs.mjs.
Grouped by the subject a reader has in mind, not by source module: module
boundaries are an implementation detail, and more than one topic here draws from
several of them. Order within a topic is reading order -- the entry point first,
then what it hands back -- so this file decides the shape of the page and not just
Every export is named exactly once. An export missing from here fails the
generator rather than quietly going undocumented, which is the same bargain
checkExports.mjs makes with its DELIBERATELY NOT EXPORTED list. The way out is
an @internal tag on the declaration, which is a decision recorded where the
declaration is read rather than a name quietly absent from this file.

tables.title: Conditions on a field
tables.lead: Called on a field or value node, and reachable as `condition(name, operands)` for building a graph programmatically. Operands are the ones passed besides the node it is called on, so `isNull` takes none and `between` takes two.

tables.title: Combining conditions
tables.lead: Called on a condition. The functional forms `and()`, `or()` and `not()` build the same nodes.

tables.title: Operations on a field
tables.lead: Called on a field, producing an expression rather than a condition, and reachable as `operation(name, operands)`. `toString` is translated into a cast to string; `asc` and `desc` are the sort directions.
